IYKYK is an acronym for the phrase 'if you know, you know'. IYKYK signals that a statement relies on knowledge shared only among insiders.

bull run denotes a sustained period of rising prices. bull run is a term used in market discussions about crypto assets.

script kiddie denotes a person with limited technical skill who relies on existing scripts or tools. script kiddie is used as an accusation of unskilled attacking of systems.

exploit denotes a method that takes advantage of a vulnerability in software or a protocol. exploit can cause losses to users of the affected system.
